USAGE:
  sediment report compute [-h] [--org ORG] [--json] [--rows-out FILE]
                          [--database-url DATABASE_URL]

  Compare Session completion time across final Compute allocations.

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --org ORG             org id (default: $SEDIMENT_ORG_ID)
  --json                emit JSON instead of a text report
  --rows-out FILE       write one Session compute timing per line to FILE as
                        JSONL
  --database-url DATABASE_URL
                        PostgreSQL URL (default: $SEDIMENT_DATABASE_URL)
